reasons.claim: Two eligible species within 250 m (2021, 10 m uncertainty): Goodyera repens (VU, vascular plant, nearest 130 m, 26 records) and Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen, 158 m; threats include lack of continuity forest and old/large trees). The rubric gives HIGH.
A third eligible species lies beyond 250 m: Haploporus odorus (VU fungus, 765 m).
12 site-bound forest NT species within 1000 m; within 250 m include Lobaria pulmonaria (60 m; one 2024 record at 79 m), Ramboldia elabens (151 m) and Chaenotheca subroscida (196 m).
No completed felling overlaps the 5.0 ha polygon. Effort is adequate (81st percentile; 16 records within 250 m).

uncertainties: Most threatened records date from 2021; current presence is unknown.
All records are outside the polygon; none are inside it.
Effort comparison uses a county sample from a short window, and only 4 observation days fall within 1000 m.
not_established: That any recorded species occupies the felling polygon.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not mean absence of species.
Nothing here says the site is safe to fell or that felling is unlawful.
next_action: Reviewer should map the 2021 Goodyera repens and Alectoria sarmentosa records against the polygon boundary and check the stand for continuity-forest and old-tree features before felling begins.
